title: #145 Social Situations
prompt: In social situations, some people believe that it is better to be a good listener than a good talker. Do you agree or disagree?

promptSegments.text: In social situations, some people believe that it is better to be a good listener than a good talker.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Listening helps build strong friendships.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Listening improves our understanding of people.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Listening improves our understanding of people.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Speaking well helps people connect with others because it allows them to share their ideas and interests.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Speaking well helps people connect with others because it allows them to share their ideas and interests.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Speaking helps people feel better because it gives them a way to express their feelings and get support.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Speaking helps people feel better because it gives them a way to express their feelings and get support.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point is that being a good listener helps people feel respected and understood, which builds trust.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point is that being a good listener helps people feel respected and understood, which builds trust.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point is that listening skills improve the quality of any conversation by showing empathy and attention.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point is that listening skills improve the quality of any conversation by showing empathy and attention.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that being a good talker is equally important to being a good listener.

angles.en: The essay provides examples showing that speaking helps people build relationships and share ideas.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
